sammendrag: Review method• Best Evidence Synthesis, six key steps • Develop working definitions for the project.• Search and select -scientific literature search (n=83), grey literature (n=28), and relevant professional practice (n=10).• Extract data (8 tables).• Generate evidence statements (10 statements).• Grade strength of evidence (4 levels).• Synthesise evidence (12 key messages).The future• More research is needed -but it works in the real world A cautionary tale!
